conclusion: Training-task design and effective learning signal need priority over further Relay mechanism changes; no demonstrated PPO sign/mask/logprob/update-order bug and no proven single cause of physical regression.
limits: Within-episode shared return is valid episodic policy-gradient supervision; variance/correlation alone does not prove biased gradients
Shadow choices on saved states are not a new closed-loop parent evaluation and cannot quantify causal fine-tune benefit
Policy has positions and indirect topology cues; absent explicit adjacency is not proof recovery is unlearnable
Historical checkpoints predate the revised objective and executor; new16episodes do not represent all prior training
No verified author GPPO repository; current task/reward are an integration adaptation, not established original-paper reproduction
No claimed15percent achievement; previous heldout remains15of16complete
priority_next: One fixed-small-training-set learnability test using existing sampler/PPO/executor: repeat sampled assignments under the same initial scenarios, verify the value baseline and within-scenario action-outcome ranking, before any further long training or Relay mechanism addition; reserve unseen seeds for subsequent acceptance.
